name: Accordion
description:
Expandable disclosure panel for organizing long sections of content such as FAQs or secondary settings.

Variants & Properties:
- State: Default | Open.

When to use: To reveal details progressively without navigating away.
When not to use: Do not use to switch between sibling views on the same screen (use Tab or Segment) or to hide critical warnings (use Alert).

whenToUse: Use to progressively disclose long sections of content such as FAQs, product details, or secondary settings without leaving the current page.
Use when users need to scan and toggle multiple collapsible sections vertically.
whenNotToUse: Do not use to switch between sibling top-level views on the same screen; use `Tabs` or `SegmentControl`.
Do not hide critical system alerts, form errors, or mandatory instructions inside collapsed panels; use `Alert` or inline copy.

behaviorRules: Implement with semantic `<button>` triggers inside headings and `role="region"` panels using WAI-ARIA disclosure keyboard interaction (`Enter`/`Space` to toggle, `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` between triggers).
Bind `aria-expanded` on each trigger and link it to its panel via `aria-controls`.
Support both single-expanded (`collapsible`) and multi-expanded modes while mapping spacing and border tokens to Tailwind CSS variables.
